dimensions.description: Selects the right skills, declares a bounded outcome, and avoids premature completion.
Follows executable production loops and records current, non-self-authored evidence.
Implements every game-specific journey, state, recovery path, control, and content boundary.
Maintains an authored identity across world, actors, FX, UI, viewports, and fresh tasks.
Produces readable goals, responsive feedback, useful game feel, tuning, and playtest clarity.
Builds reliably with performance, accessibility, localization, licensing, and target evidence.
Finishes within the declared budget and recovers cleanly from failed generation or tooling.
